description: BRA23F-E001 occurred at the federal Health Ministry and was described as involving 'few people'; no exact number is available and the threshold may be below 50. The one open report is a syndicated Estadão Content story, not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Search permitted independent Brasília local news, Indigenous organization records, or official accounts for a site-specific attendance number; do not reuse the syndicated versions as independent evidence.

description: BRA23F-E002 is confirmed in Rio by union reporting, but no participant estimate/qualitative threshold evidence is published in the opened account. The coordinated call and separate São Paulo lead cannot be pooled to satisfy the site-level threshold.
required_followup: Search contemporary Rio local reporting and public/union documentation for a count at the Avenida Presidente Vargas gathering; assess other cities as independent sites.

description: The open-web sweep used Portuguese general searches across all four weekly windows and sector/region queries (including Rio Grande do Norte education and national monetary-policy actions); English searches were general early-month only, with no English late-February weekly/regional sector sweep. Open web does not substitute for LexisNexis.
required_followup: If another version is authorized, run new English-language late-February and regional/sector queries, not repeated broad searches; check local press for underrepresented regions and sectors.

description: No cross-month continuation was verified for either February candidate. E002 is reported as a one-day date-specific protest, but its physical end is not reported; other location-level actions in the national call were not examined as episode continuations.
required_followup: Search non-duplicate reporting immediately after 14 February for Rio protest continuation/close and check separately whether any announced site action is ongoing; do not infer an end from publication date.
